nary_nodes.label: European heatwave
evidence: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June as forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.
nary_nodes.type_definition: A period of abnormally hot weather.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Excess deaths in France
evidence: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June as forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.
In France, the number of deaths recorded between 22 and 28 June increased by 2,025 - nearly 30%, the Public Health France agency announced on Friday.
nary_nodes.type_definition: The number of deaths resulting from a particular cause.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Hottest day in France
evidence: France saw its hottest day ever on average country-wide on 24 June, with temperatures hitting almost 41C in Paris and half the nation placed under a red heat alert.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of setting a temperature record.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Forecast of extreme heat
evidence: News of the death toll comes with parts of Europe, including the UK, braced for more searing temperatures from this weekend.
BBC Weather says a large area of high pressure is currently building from the Azores towards Portugal and Spain and that by the weekend, heat is forecast to climb across France and southern Britain.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: US heatwave
evidence: And as Europe braces for sweltering conditions, millions of Americans celebrating the July Fourth holiday weekend are already being affected by prolonged extreme heat and high humidity in parts of the central and eastern US.
nary_nodes.type_definition: A period of abnormally hot weather.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Climate change impact
evidence: Climate change is driving up temperatures around the world - but particularly in Europe.
It is the fastest warming continent, heating up twice as fast as the global average, according to the Copernicus climate service.
This is causing increased summer heatwaves, greater pressure on Europe's water supply, and more intense wildfires.
nary_nodes.type_definition: A long-term change in global climate patterns.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Excess deaths in Belgium
evidence: Belgium recorded 1,222 excess deaths during the heatwave – 39% more than usual – with almost half being people aged 85 and over.
The country's health ministry said the number of deaths during a heatwave was "unprecedented".
nary_nodes.type_definition: The number of deaths resulting from a particular cause.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Excess deaths in Netherlands
evidence: Meanwhile, unprecedented heat in the Netherlands last week led to about 480 excess deaths, Dutch authorities said on Thursday - most of whom were aged 80 and older.
nary_nodes.type_definition: The number of deaths resulting from a particular cause.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Drowning deaths in France
evidence: Drowning deaths soared during the heatwave, with French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez saying on Saturday that 72 people had died by drowning since 18 June.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Wildfires in France
evidence: On Thursday, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said nearly 7,000 fires had broken out since the start of the summer season, with about 8,700 hectares burned so far.
Nearly 3,000 people were evacuated after a wildfire ignited in the town of Sainte-Marie-la-Mer and spread to Canet-en-Roussillon on Thursday.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An uncontrolled fire in a natural area.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Red alerts for forest fires
evidence: Météo-France has issued red alerts for Friday and Saturday for forest fires in the southern part of the country, warning that weather conditions meant the risk of an outbreak was "very high" compared to summer norms.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An official warning about hazardous weather.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Iberian heatwave warning
evidence: In the Iberian Peninsula, Aemet weather service has warned of the possibility of another heatwave.
Portugal's government declared a state of alert which will remain in place until midnight on Tuesday.
In Spain, areas of the southwest are on orange alert as 40C is expected in some parts.
nary_nodes.type_definition: A period of abnormally hot weather.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits; minting as Event subtype.
